SECTION D: Long Answer Type Questions (5 Marks Each)

Q33. (a) Define Globalisation. Describe the factors that have enabled the process of 
globalisation.  
OR  
(b) “Foreign trade integrates the markets in different countries.” Support the statement 
with arguments.

Answer / Solution:
(a) Define Globalisation. Describe the factors that have enabled it. 
Definition: Rapid integration of countries through trade, investment, and 
technology. 
Factors: 
1. Technology: Improvements in transport and IT/communication. 
2. Liberalisation: Removal of trade barriers and investment restrictions. 
3. MNCs: Companies producing globally to lower costs. 
OR (b) “Foreign trade integrates the markets in different countries.” Support the 
statement. 
Choice: Consumers get access to global goods. 
Competition: Producers compete globally, improving quality/price. 
Market Access: Producers can sell in foreign markets, integrating economies.
